SYMPTOM: SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit hook errors in Claude Code after installing memory system
CAUSE: Claude Code's hook runner doesn't source .zshrc, so bun isn't in PATH. Hooks using bare 'bun' command fail.
FIX: Replace all 'bun' in hook commands with '/Users/ned/.bun/bin/bun' in ~/.claude/settings.json
PREVENT: Any future hooks using bun or other user-installed tools need full paths
